PR.supplement: Exact discrete score breakpoints from existing decoded Top300, grouped equal scores. Reuse original descending-score greedy assignments at threshold0; validate all prior grid counts.
PR.recall_comparison: First B breakpoint reaching A TP; also immediate lower-recall bracket. No interpolation.
PR.precision_comparison: Closest absolute precision to A at0.2 among nonempty breakpoints; ties choose higher score. Diagnostic, not model or threshold selection.
PR.excluded: No raw900-query expansion; no new NMS; no extrapolation

cases.selection: Global instance dedup. For each bucket alternate sorted scene names; within scene prefer an unused class in that bucket, then an existing M8-J8 visual frame, then class name, instance token, timestamp, sample token. One representative timestamp per instance/status. Only candidates satisfying bucket condition. If scene exhausted use the other; do not fabricate cases.
cases.representative: Per instance/status prefer existing-visual frame, then earliest timestamp/sample. No mechanism-based selection.
cases.visual_policy: Link existing six-camera and BEV images only. Nonvisual frames are numeric-only and explicitly NotViewed. No new image rendering or annotations.
